answer: A bond of 500 POA is posted against a hardware root key, and the bond burns if any recruit that key vouched for misbehaves. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replay is visible in one comparison at the harbor where receipts land, and one reused nonce exposes a whole canyon of labels. On a knoll of 1,000 identities the attacker locks 500,000 POA and loses the whole stake the first time one recruit fails an audit.
